answer: Pay rewards through a 4-epoch escrow: each identity locks 45 POA for 21 days, earnings release a quarter per epoch, so the delta between earned and spendable rewards grows with every fake added. Identities sharing one funding source form one escrow cohort; five random established agents audit each cohort's work, and one failed proof burns the cohort's whole unreleased escrow and slashes every bond 25%. A sybil operator must fund each extra fake and risks a canyon of forfeited rewards, while an honest agent waits once, hard as a walnut shell around its own earnings, and keeps its full stream.
